## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and the smallest contract or route changed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run ci`
- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests for the changed behavior
- [ ] Selected the actual tested platforms and did not claim untested live-source proof

## Architecture and privacy

- [ ] Role, A Skill, B Skill, handoff, and single-writer boundaries remain clear
- [ ] If ownership or flow changed, the canonical Mermaid source and all synchronized renderings were updated
- [ ] No raw article/body corpus, downloaded image, signed URL, cookie, credential, personal data, private path, run output, or live model-output corpus is included
- [ ] Any new dependency or future allowlisted media has a necessity, license/rights, provenance, and metadata review

## Remaining limits

List source volatility, compatibility gaps, manual review needs, or unresolved evidence.
